title: 超高对比度
description: 更好的高对比度材质包，将UI的默认按钮设置为半透明的，还额外改了一些提示和快捷栏。High-contrast pack with semi-transparent UI, tweaked tooltips, and a cleaner hotbar.
body:
(https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0ab233aa06118803d0480d93ad285838f56da526.png)提供了半透明的默认UI，部分按钮重新绘制。游戏内部查看的包和存档的默认图标经过修改，创造模式选择物品类型的框只剩下一个白色轮廓，快捷栏更加简洁且带有数字，书本翻页的箭头改成块状的。
English:Provides a semi-transparent default UI, with some buttons redrawn. The default icons for data packs and single-server saves in the in-game menus have been modified. The box for selecting item types in Creative mode is now just a white outline. The hotbar is cleaner and includes numbers, and the book page-turning arrows have been changed to a block-style shape with a pointed tip.
